message: ぺったんこ
The same strange feeling as before...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be... you forgot something again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah, yeah, that's right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun... you haven't been bringing Student Council work home and losing sleep over it, have you? You mustn't push yourself too hard.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine. I'm not pushing myself at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai. There is no way Sakura-kun is that wholesome! It's merely carelessness, or--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Early-onset amnesia?」

name: Synn
message: 「As if!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It must be Alzheimer's.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's even worse.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then, Synn. Do you remember the promise we made ten years ago?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ten years ago...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did you forget...?」
Urgh... I-I have to remember this no matter what it takes!

name: Synn
message: 「W-wait a second! I'll remember it right now!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You say that... but you don't remember at all... You probably didn't think much of it anyway, so I guess it can't be helped...」

name: Synn
message: 「Time out! It's right on the tip of my brain!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is no need to remember!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To put it plainly, it was a promise to get married!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wha--」

name: Synn
message: 「I-is that what it was?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course. You two are childhood friends, after all. That's only natural.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have heard that human childhood friends easily make those kinds of promises in the folly of youth.」

name: Misa
message: 「Knowing how thoughtless Sakura-kun is, I could see him making a promise like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Nanaka! I don't remember it at all...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Ah, um, well, even if you apologize so seriously.\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. The coming and going of youth happens all the time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, well, I mean, we never made a promise like that in the first place.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whaat!? Both the President and the Treasurer are failures as childhood friends.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, 'failures'?! Listen, just because people are childhood friends doesn't mean they all promise to get married!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right, Lolotte-chan. If childhood friends are two boys or two girls, they can't make a promise like that, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way! They can't?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I mean, since it's a promise between little kids, maybe that happens too... Some people have those tastes and preferences, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, what are we even talking about?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um. Anyway. So with that, bye for today!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean 'with that'... Well, whatever. See you tomorrow, then.」

name: Ria
message: 「Bye-bye, Synn-kun. See you tomorrow.」

name: Misa
message: 「Goodbye.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'We shall never forget your noble sacrifice!' That's the right line here, isn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... I don't really know what to say to that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just like last time, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think so.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I bet it's another transfer student. Good grief.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... huh...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord, this thing's a barrier.」

name: Synn
message: 「A barrier?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon Lord can feel the power of a barrier, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...? No way...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Who knows. Well, even a human could put up one this weak.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Barriers are the kind of thing that'll activate even if the caster doesn't have any special powers, as long as they're made following strict rules.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that how it works~」

name: Paqy
message: 「The real question is why she put up a barrier in the first place.」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it.」
Still, a barrier... why would Azel?

name: Paqy
message: 「She's totally flat.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-what is?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Her tits, obviously. Since she's doing the backstroke, I can see 'em real clearly.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Abyss!」

name: Azel
message: 「Who's there!」
I quickly hid Paqy.

name: Synn
message: 「Uh... Student Council President?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's... you again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you remember that you aren't supposed to use the pool without permission?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you that the other day, didn't I?」

name: Azel
message: 「I forgot.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not saying you can't use it at all. Just get proper permission if you want to swim... Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you the only one here, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I don't know.」
Is everyone else off today?
Could it be... the barrier's power?
Paqy called her a mysterious transfer student, and Azel really is a mystery.
Still, if I ask her directly right now, she probably won't answer.

name: Synn
message: 「Do you like swimming?」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want to swim, how about joining a club? I think that way, you wouldn't have to sneak around to swim like this.」

name: Azel
message: 「No need.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, using the pool without permission is--」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a club.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, a club is where everyone does what they like with their schoolmates using the school's facilities... I guess.」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you say that, then what you were just doing--swimming--would be pointless too, don't you think.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it pointless?」

name: Synn
message: 「Putting the school rules aside for now... if you don't think it's pointless, Azel, then I don't think it is.」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so? You looked like you were having fun, though.」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey. Aren't you forcing yourself to call it pointless?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's not true.」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen. When you watch TV or read the newspaper, there are actually lots of people who love to say that things like play are all pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「But even those people will shamelessly say the things they don't think are pointless aren't pointless. They'll say it's good for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Or they make excuses like they're doing it because it's educational... I think that kind of thing is lame.」

name: Azel
message: 「What are you trying to say?」

name: Synn
message: 「I just don't get why you'd call something fun... and something you like doing, pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, maybe it doesn't help other people, or it might even be a bother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, if the person themselves is having fun, you can't really call it completely pointless, right... Though it'd definitely be a problem if they went overboard.」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Azel
message: 「I told you not to tell anyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't tell. Still, make sure you get permission before using the pool, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't tell anyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I already said I won't, wait-could it be you don't know how to get permission? If so, I can do it for you--」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you--」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... what?」
She left...

name: Azel
message: 「Don't tell anyone!」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't!」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't you dare tell.」
She really left this time...
Wait, no!

name: Synn
message: 「How many times do I have to say it, you can't just go into the pool without permission!」
Did she hear me?

name: Synn
message: 「You can't do thaaaaat!」
Silence.

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up.」
Looks like she changed clothes in the blink of an eye.

name: Synn
message: 「If you heard me, then answer me.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll make sure I'm not found.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not the poiiint!」

name: Azel
message: 「As long as I'm not found, it's fine, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I found you!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why.」

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Azel
message: 「Why were you the only one who noticed?」
Could it be because I'm the Demon Lord?

name: Azel
message: 「I'll make sure not to get caught next time.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not the problem!」
She ignored me and walked off......

name: Synn
message: 「What?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... Impressive as always, Demon Lord. Not satisfied with the Student Council girls (minus Ria-chan), you're already hitting on a new one. Truly, a hero loves bea--」

name: Paqy
message: 「NOOOOOOO.」
How does Azel...... know how to set up a barrier, anyway.
